facts.fact: The World Bank appraisal says the previous strategy Maroc Numérique 2013 lacked a strong implementation structure, which led in 2017 to the creation of the Digital Development Agency (ADD) to centralise operational efforts on digital government.

The appraisal calls Maroc Numérique 2013 the 'previous strategy' and 'the earlier digital transformation strategy'; no end date is given, so the date used is the document's publication date, 22 November 2021.

The appraisal reports that in 2019 the Court of Accounts found the various digital strategies had not fully met their objectives, with 23 percent of services fully digitised against a goal of 100 percent.
facts.system: various digital strategies (Court of Accounts evaluation of online public services)

facts.fact: The appraisal says the 2021 New Development Model calls for the preparation of a new national digital strategy and a unique digital platform for all digital services; no drafting or adoption is reported.
